Critique 2 on v2 — PASS, 0 blocking, 1 advisory (F11). Written to 03-critique-2.md. F1 verified landed by data-class diff v1->v2, which contains only the F1/F3/F4 edits. New b13 block sound: w-[343px] gone, b13 web bag matches s11 Page shell body half verbatim, b02 is the canvas half alone, no ids renumbered, c01-c20 unchanged plus c21. Fix is a label/Unsure line naming the canvas as page root, NOT a height class.

Approval sealed by the reviewer invoking /design build. 04-approval.md written with the concept name, sha256, ISO time and the verbatim invoking message. No concept edit was made, so the sealed hash remains valid.

BUILD: OK — 9 files, 13/13 blocks, 4 states, 1 planned composition, 0 questions. Builder verified the approval hash itself before starting; orchestrator re-confirmed concept.v2.html still hashes to b1cc6bb0... so the seal holds. Package has the route, 5 components, mapping.md, contract.json, HANDOFF.md. Orchestrator re-ran both tools independently: class-audit PASS 51/51 sanctioned 0 violations; handoff-check PASS 13/13 blocks, 4 states, 21 copy, 0 failures, 0 warnings (re-run with --sprite src/icons/sprite.svg, so icon existence IS checked and every referenced icon exists). All three reviewer decisions built in: name row stands as drawn and HANDOFF states it settled; footer offset recorded as open item O1 classified s1.2 methodology-gap with no padding invented; b02 named page root in mapping.md and HANDOFF as a label only, no height class. FLAGGED FOR GATE 6 — builder judgement call D1: the concept declares a class bag per viewport but the package is one artifact, so bags merge mobile-first over md. Every merge is a plain md: prefix except b13's 16px mobile gutter, which the builder MOVED to b02 as px-4, on the reasoning that md:px-0 is unsanctioned and leaving p-4 on b13 would give the web column 528px inside w-140 instead of the 560 that s1.1/s4 and the w-67+gap-6+w-67 name row require exactly. Needs adversarial review. Also flagged: contract.copy rows carry verbatimInMarkup:false because the concept's copy elements append spec prose after the string.

VERIFY: PASS — 0 blocking, 4 advisories, all document accuracy. Written to 06-verify-1.md. D1 gutter move independently checked at both viewports and sound: at 375 px-4 on b02 gives 343 with b13 declaring no width (identical to the concept); at >=md b13 is md:w-140 with no x-padding so the name row closes at 268+24+268, and b02's inset never touches the centred column. Rejected alternatives confirmed worse (p-4 on b13 yields 528 at md; md:px-0 unsanctioned; w-[343px] overflows at 320). Copy byte-compared against 01-brief.md — every rendered string matches exactly, spec prose never reaches markup. All three reviewer decisions honoured. Advisories carried to the writeup, not fixed: verification passed and rework is mandated only on FAIL.
